description: This file defines the ApplicationAutoScalingClient class, which extends AwsClient, and provides methods to interact with the Application Auto Scaling service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations like deleting, describing, and updating scaling policies and targets.

classes.name: ApplicationAutoScalingClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the Application Auto Scaling service in AWS. It provides methods to manage scaling policies, scheduled actions, scalable targets, and related resources.

methods.name: deleteScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specified scaling policy.

methods.name: deleteScheduledActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a scheduled scaling action.

methods.name: getPredictiveScalingForecast
methods.description: Retrieves a forecast for predictive scaling.

methods.name: getPredictiveScalingForecastAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a forecast for predictive scaling.

methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a scaling policy.
